items.question: How safe is Colombia?
items.answer: Medellin felt remarkably safe to us in the areas we visited, especially relative to the city's reputation. Cartagena's main issue for us was harassment from sellers rather than fear of violence. Bogota felt grittier during our short stop, so we would use standard big-city caution.

items.question: Is English commonly understood?
items.answer: Do not rely on it. Tourist-facing businesses will often manage, but Spanish improves almost every interaction.

items.question: What could ruin my stay in Colombia?
items.answer: Bringing the 1990s with you. Colombia's history matters, but treating every place as a Narcos set does a disservice to the country you are actually visiting. Also, Cartagena at midday. Respect the humidity.
